title: Resistor network, Bourns 4600X SIP, isolated (102 circuit)
readingTypes: 46nnX_102_vvv: nn the pin count (even), vvv the resistance code
pinRule: resistor k runs from pin 2k-1 to pin 2k (1-2, 3-4, ...), so a 4608X has 8 pins and 4 resistors
values: resistance code as for the 101 circuit
datasheet: Bourns 4600X datasheet, page 2, Isolated Resistors (102 Circuit)

sources.document: Bourns 4600X Series Thick Film Conformal SIPs, REV. 10/1/20

note: Datasheet: 2 to 7 isolated resistors of equal value, each between two pins; 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 or 14 pins; 0.30 W per resistor at 70 C.
